purpose: Check whether six fixed demonstrations recover arithmetic capability before expanding source discovery
budget: At most600driver seconds using existingGPT2Medium;282queries, no source fitting, new model or training.
scope: Development after weak zero-shot source results. Six fixed addition examples prime each prompt form. Those six operand pairs are excluded from every query; all94remaining pairs are evaluated for each of3forms. Numeric-candidate and full-vocabulary accuracy both reported. This diagnoses model/task suitability, not SAE correspondence or official benchmark performance.
precision: highest throughout; source/native maps and every actual model forward recomputed with consistent full float32 matrix multiplication. No R25 cached hidden values reused.
consumer_statistics_unit: Five disjoint source-target pairs per mechanism conditional on prior source selection; old exposed generated grammar pairs. Development summaries, not population confirmation.
